generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A re-audit package can appear cumulative while importing history from another target, and an omitted classification field can silently downgrade the validation path that would detect the contamination.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Build cumulative state from every inherited package and default absent remediation classification to the least strict mode instead of deriving target lineage and mode from certified authoritative inputs.
generalized_learning.reusable_control: Bind cumulative lineage to the immediately previous immutable snapshot of the same target, and derive remediation strictness from the certified remediation ledger on both producer and consumer sides.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Foreign historical packages are diagnostic inputs only and cannot introduce active or retired lineage IDs; certificate classification is derived from the certified remediation ledger.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Re-audit readiness compares current lineage with the immutable immediately previous target snapshot and independently derives systemic/mixed mode from the certified ledger when necessary.

transfer_cases.case: a branch inherits an audit package from another issue and attempts to retire those IDs into the current issue ledger
a legacy certificate omits remediation_mode while the certified remediation ledger is systemic

skill_changes.change: Producer rejects historical-only retirement injection and writes remediation_mode from the certified audit-remediation ledger.
Auditor derives remediation mode from the certified ledger when needed and executes systemic re-audit readiness rather than silently defaulting to targeted.
